svg.title: Agent-assisted delivery — human-approved progress
svg.desc: Repository-defined program workflow: planning, human eval approval, spec freeze, serial development and testing, eval coverage, corpus replay, final verification, PR review and next phase.
svg.text: AGENTIC SDLC · FROM REQUEST TO REVIEWABLE CODE
Program route — new applications and phased changes to existing systems
Source: repository commands, stage handlers and eval helper · Reviewed 25 September 2026
Describe the requirement → detect existing code and select the application type.
Existing code: survey + human triage first (see Existing-system routes). Optional brainstorming can supply the request.
Before freeze: technical feedback → Architect; requirements → BA; criterion changes → Technical Lead (or Fix Planner).
Re-review changed artifacts and return to the eval gate. After freeze, upstream edits are blocked; cancel/start a new run.
06 BUILD & VERIFY — ONE STORY AT A TIME
Process dependency waves in order, then story ID. Web: .NET / React · Desktop: Electron · Firmware: ESP-IDF.
Story passes → next story (until all are complete)
Test defects or missing tags → Test Engineer. Production defects → Engineer → code review → tests again.
Full suite at each wave end; every brownfield story uses the full suite and compares against the recorded baseline.
Replay failure → repair the regression, or review an intentional retirement/supersession of the old criterion.
07 FINAL VERIFICATION — CHOOSE THE APPLICATION ROUTE
After corpus replay passes. Existing systems run this stage only when infrastructure or packaging changes are required.
Firmware build · size budget · host tests
Config failure → DevOps / Packager. App bug → owning story’s code + test loops → final verification again.
Five-iteration limits and ambiguous final-review findings escalate to a human for guidance.
Final checks pass (or permitted brownfield skip) → branch ready for review
More phases? Start next phase after merge.
Optional replan of remaining phases → Architect (03).
Human icons mark defined approval or shipping decisions; development and final verification have no routine per-loop human approval.
Eval checks are coverage/link checks, not another test runner. assert/judge execution is not implemented in the current helper.
Blue robot = creator agent · teal robot = AI validator/reviewer · check circle = automated helper · orange person = human
